# Liquid Pixel

> Liquid Pixel is a boutique digital agency in McAllen, Texas, specializing in immersive 360° virtual tours, video production, augmented reality experiences, 360 drone services, and TapGenie NFC digital business cards. We make Rio Grande Valley businesses impossible to ignore — turning a location into a sales tool customers can explore before they ever arrive.

## About
- Business: Liquid Pixel Digital Agency
- Location: McAllen, TX — serving the Rio Grande Valley and all of Texas
- Founder: RC Cepeda
- Contact: rc@liquidpixel.io · (956) 802-9541
- Hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM
- Price range: $999–$2,999+
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/liquidpixelagency/

## Services
- [Virtual Tours](https://liquidpixel.io/virtualtours): Immersive 360° virtual tours that let customers walk through a space before they arrive, published straight to Google.
- [Corporate Virtual Tours](https://liquidpixel.io/virtual-tours-corporate): 360° tours for offices, coworking spaces, gyms, museums, and campuses.
- [Hospitality Virtual Tours](https://liquidpixel.io/virtual-tours-hospitality): 360° tours for hotels, restaurants, bars, and event venues.
- [Real Estate Virtual Tours](https://liquidpixel.io/virtual-tours-real-estate): 360° tours for real estate agents, luxury homes, and property managers.
- [Retail Virtual Tours](https://liquidpixel.io/virtual-tours-retail): 360° tours for retail stores, showrooms, and dealerships.
- Custom Digital Business Cards (TapGenie): NFC-powered digital cards that share contact info, social links, and portfolios in one tap.
- 360 Drone Services: Aerial and 360° drone capture for property, events, and venues.
- Augmented Reality Experiences: Interactive AR that brings a brand, product, or venue to life on any phone.
- Video Production & Content Creation: Scroll-stopping photo and video content for social and brand storytelling.
